description: This Swift source file defines a controller for a hover-only HUD (Heads-Up Display) that is anchored to the menu bar in macOS. It manages the display, positioning, and interaction behaviors of the HUD, which includes a SwiftUI view. The class handles hover state changes, showing and dismissing the HUD with animations, and opening a chat panel. It also contains internal view code for rendering the HUD interface.

classes.name: HoverHUDController
classes.description: A final class managing the lifecycle and interactions of a hover HUD in macOS, including showing, hiding, positioning, and user interaction.

methods.name: setSuppressed
methods.description: Sets whether the HUD is suppressed, cancelling show/dismiss tasks accordingly.

methods.name: statusItemHoverChanged
methods.description: Handles hover state changes over the status item, scheduling the HUD to appear after a delay when hovered.

methods.name: panelHoverChanged
methods.description: Handles hover over the panel, cancelling dismiss delays or scheduling dismissal upon hover exit.

methods.name: openChat
methods.description: Opens the chat window by dismissing the HUD and invoking the WebChatManager.

methods.name: dismiss
methods.description: Dismisses the HUD, with an optional reason parameter, removing the window with animation.

methods.name: scheduleDismiss
methods.description: Schedules the dismissal of the HUD after a delay unless still hovered.

methods.name: present
methods.description: Prepares and displays the HUD window at the target position.

methods.name: ensureWindow
methods.description: Creates the HUD window if it does not already exist.

methods.name: targetFrame
methods.description: Calculates the position and size frame for the HUD window based on anchor point.

methods.name: updateWindowFrame
methods.description: Updates the window frame to the target position, with optional animation.

methods.name: installDismissMonitor
methods.description: Sets up global mouse event monitoring to dismiss the HUD when clicking outside.

methods.name: removeDismissMonitor
methods.description: Removes the global mouse event monitor.
